title: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to "Air Plan Approval; South Dakota; Regional Haze Plan for the Second Implementation Period".
short_title: Repeal of the Environmental Protection Agency rule on Air Plan Approval; South Dakota; Regional Haze Plan for the Second Implementatio…
subjects: Wilderness and natural areas, wildlife refuges, wild rivers, habitats
committees: S-Environment and Public Works Committee: Referred To 2025-10-01 -> Discharged From 2025-12-09
latest_action: Motion to proceed to consideration of measure rejected in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 43 - 50. Record Vote Number: 4.
summary: This joint resolution nullifies the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) final rule titled Air Plan Approval; South Dakota; Regional Haze Plan for the Second Implementation Period (90 Fed. Reg. 41893) and published on August 28, 2025. The final rule approved South Dakota’s revision to its state implementation plan to satisfy the requirements of the EPA’s regional haze rule. (The regional haze rule requires states to take actions to improve visibility in national parks and wilderness areas.)

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
